newsitem.title: UK: First oil flows from Shell/Esso North Sea facility.
newsitem.headline: First oil flows from Shell/Esso North Sea facility.

text.p: Shell U.K. Exploration and Production said Monday the first oil flowed over the weekend from Anasuria, the biggest floating production storage and offtake (FPSO) facility in the North Sea.

The startup of Anasuria, which is being used for the combined development of three central North Sea oil fields located 175 km east of Aberdeen, Scotland, was about eight weeks ahead of schedule and within budget, Shell Expro said.
It said oil production would gradually build up to an estimated 60,000 bpd by the end of the year.
Anasuria is a purpose-built, turret moored vessel with a storage capacity of about 850,000 barrels of oil.
It is operated by Shell Expro on behalf of Royal Dutch Petroleum Co /Shell Transport and Trading Plc and Esso U.K., a subsidiary of Exxon Corp.
